content: {"summary":"To determine why the feature store is refusing writes, check Redis persistence and memory status. If rdb_last_bgsave_status is \"err\" the node is in the MISCONF path (snapshot failure). If used_memory equals maxmemory with noeviction policy, the node is in the OOM path (full). Additionally, inspect system logs for fork allocation errors or disk‑full conditions that cause BGSAVE failures.","likely_cause":"Not applicable – the question asks for diagnostic steps rather than a specific incident","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Check rdb_last_bgsave_status; \"err\" indicates snapshot (MISCONF) failure, while used_memory at maxmemory with noeviction indicates OOM (full).","evidence_ids":["RB-019#1"],"quote":"rdb_last_bgsave_status:err -> MISCONF path # used_memory at maxmemory, noeviction -> OOM path"},{"text":"Snapshot failures can stem from fork memory allocation errors; look for \"fork: Cannot allocate memory\" in the Redis server journal.","evidence_ids":["RB-019#2"],"quote":"\"fork: Cannot allocate memory\" -> commit limit"},{"text":"Disk exhaustion of the RDB directory also causes BGSAVE to fail; verify free space on the RDB path.","evidence_ids":["RB-019#2"],"quote":"disk full on the RDB dir also fails BGSAVE"},{"text":"When snapshots fail, Redis stops accepting writes as documented in incident notes.","evidence_ids":["INC-0078#1"],"quote":"snapshot attempts were failing, and Redis stops accepting writes"}],"next_checks":["Run \"INFO persistence\" and examine rdb_last_bgsave_status","Run \"INFO memory\" and compare used_memory_human to maxmemory_human","Check system journal for \"fork: Cannot allocate memory\" messages","Check disk usage of the RDB directory with \"df -h\""]}
